reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 6 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 33% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 17%.

reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.
In the customer's last 6 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 33% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 17%.
